nodes.label: Vite Lightning Bolt Favicon
nodes.description: 48x46 SVG app icon: a stylized lightning-bolt shape filled purple (#863bff) with masked, blurred inner ellipses in violet (#7e14ff), lavender (#ede6ff) and cyan (#47bfff) forming a glowing gradient. This is the default Vite scaffold favicon used as the browser-tab icon of the frontend app.
nodes.rationale: Left as the Vite template default; not customized branding.
